idea-plugin.name: WebChatHelper
idea-plugin.description:
Runs the ChatGPT web UI inside the IDE and automates working with project files.

  • ChatGPT in an embedded browser (JCEF) in a tool window on the right of the IDE.
  • Attach project files and folders to the prompt, with configurable exclusions.
  • Diff code from ChatGPT's responses against project files.

Uses the ChatGPT website with your own login. It does not use any OpenAI APIs.
